title: Meeting 1: Kick-off
summary: Turn first ideas and open questions into a clear agenda.
coachDoes: Builds a short agenda for the time you have
Lists questions for your supervisor, most important first
Helps you find a direction if you have no topic yet

title: Meeting 2: Follow-up
summary: Build on meeting 1 without reopening what was decided.
coachDoes: Reuses your kick-off sheet and your after-meeting notes
Separates what was decided from what is still open
Focuses the agenda on the open points

title: Regular meeting
summary: Keep each progress meeting short and focused.
coachDoes: Summarises progress since the last meeting

title: Mid-term preparation
summary: Take stock of the work halfway through.
coachDoes: Helps you structure a progress overview
Lists what to verify with the right office

title: Pre-submission
summary: Get ready for the last feedback round before you hand in.
coachDoes: Builds an agenda for the final feedback
Keeps the focus on the next steps
